business_problem: Emergent Labs needed a flexible, scalable database to support AI agents building and iterating on vibe-coded applications.
solution_summary: Emergent Labs needed a flexible, scalable database to support AI agents building and iterating on vibe-coded applications. The flexible document structure of MongoDB enables rapid iteration and development, allowing AI agents to dynamically adapt schemas. Through “vibe coding,” users describe what to build while autonomous AI agents write the code, test it, and refine it based on their feedback. “The software industry has been like a movie production house, where you need a big budget and large teams to produce software,” said Mukund Jha, Co-founder and CEO of Emergent Labs. The Emergent Labs team initially tried PostgreSQL, but it found that the agents frequently got stuck in schema migration loops when trying to add or delete columns as users added new functionality to their applications. “We found very early on that MongoDB Atlas was the best choice for our platform, especially for nondevelopers.

solution_components.name: MongoDB Atlas
solution_components.role: Provides the managed document database backing Emergent Labs's modernized application platform.

data_flow: Operational data from legacy or distributed applications is consolidated in MongoDB Atlas, where flexible document models support microservices, APIs, and downstream user experiences without batch-heavy synchronization. Upstream and downstream integrations include AWS, APIs.
business_outcome: In four months, nearly 2 million applications were built on Emergent Labs’ platform across 180 countries.
metrics: In four months, nearly 2 million applications were built on Emergent Labs’ platform across 180 countries.
